description: This file contains utility functions for handling forecast series data in charts, including extracting series context, formatting tooltip series, rebasing forecast data, and reordering forecast series for visualization.

methods.name: extractForecastSeriesContext
methods.description: Extracts the context (name and type) of a forecast series from its series name using regex matching.

methods.name: extractForecastSeriesContexts
methods.description: Aggregates multiple series names into a mapping of base names to their forecast series types.

methods.name: extractForecastValuesFromTooltipParams
methods.description: Extracts forecast-related values from tooltip parameters, considering chart orientation.

methods.name: formatForecastTooltipSeries
methods.description: Formats forecast series data into tooltip display strings, including observation, trend, and confidence bounds.

methods.name: rebaseForecastDatum
methods.description: Rebases forecast data, adjusting upper confidence bounds by subtracting lower bounds, and applies verbose mapping.

methods.name: reorderForecastSeries
methods.description: Reorders forecast series on charts based on predefined sort order for confidence bands and forecast components.
